info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Fares-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Fare Retrieval API allows users to access detailed fare information for rideshare services. By querying this endpoint, consumers can obtain real-time fare estimates based on various ride parameters such as distance, time, and service type. This API is primarily aimed at developers integrating rideshare functionalities into applications aiming to provide users with accurate cost estimates for their rides. Use cases include mobile apps, websites, and platforms seeking to enhance user experiences with cost transparency.

get.summary: Retrieve the fare for a specific ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to get the fare estimate for a ride based on the pickup and drop-off locations. You can use this to inform your users about pricing before they confirm their ride request.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the fare details for a ride. Include the necessary parameters to retrieve accurate fare information.

ListRideshareRidesFaresRequest.description: This schema represents the payload for the request body when retrieving fare information for rides. It is a string that must conform to the required format.
